title: Never lose a great idea again: Your personalized library arrives on Sports Content Playbook
author: Martí
excerpt: Sports Content Playbook introduces a new feature allowing creators to save formats and ideas into a personalized library for future sports content inspiration.
body_html:
As a content creator in the high-paced sports world, you know inspiration is volatile. You stumble upon a brilliant format, think «I need to try this,» but weeks later, when you actually need it, it has vanished into the vastness of the feed. That ends now.

We are thrilled to announce a key upgrade to Sports Content Playbook designed to supercharge your workflow. Inside our «Content Ideas» section, you now have the power to save.

How does the new section work? We have integrated an intuitive functionality just like the one you already use on platforms like Instagram or TikTok—but focused 100% on content creation in sports. When browsing our repository of examples, you will see a new bookmark icon. With a single click, you can save whatever catches your eye directly to your personal profile.

What can you save? It’s no longer just about remembering a cool image. You can archive specific viral video formats, innovative graphic concepts, smart storytelling ideas, or copy structures that actually perform.

Build your creative arsenal This new feature allows you to build a curated, bespoke library of inspiration, tailored to your specific role, the sport you cover, or your overall social media strategy. Everything you save remains instantly accessible, ready to be retrieved, adapted to your brand, or shared with your team exactly when the moment comes to create.

Stop taking screenshots that get lost in your phone’s camera roll. Log in now to Sports Content Playbook, explore the Content Ideas section, and start turning inspiration into action.
